job.question: In the 2021 version of ILPA's ESG Assessment Framework FAQ, how many resources are listed in answer to 'Where can I find additional resources pertaining to ESG?', and what are they?
job.expected_facts: 6 resources: ILPA's ESG Roadmap; ILPA's Diversity in Action Initiative; UNPRI's Private Equity Page; Sustainability Accounting Standards Board (SASB); Task Force on Climate Related Financial Disclosures (TCFD); The Institutional Investors Group on Climate Change (IIGCC).
job.acceptance: Accept six and recognisable names/acronyms. No publication-date proof is required in the answer; do not mix in the two additional 2024 resources.

reviews.reason: This is the September 2024 revision, not the 2021 version. It lists eight current resources and explicitly confirms only that SASB was previously listed; it does not establish the 2021 list of six or identify all six resources.
quotes: The Framework was first released in 2021 and most recently revised in September of 2024.
the Sustainability Accounting Standards Board (SASB), which was previously listed in this FAQ

quotes: The Framework was first released in 2021 and most recently revised in September of 2024.
Where can I find additional resources pertaining to ESG?
• ILPA’s ESG and Sustainable Investing Hub
• ILPA’s Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Hub
• IFRS’s International Sustainability Standards Board (ISSB) – note, the Sustainability Accounting Standards Board (SASB), which was previously listed in this FAQ, is now part of the IFRS Foundation
• Task Force on Climate-Related Financial Disclosures
• The Institutional Investors Group on Climate Change (IIGCC)
